description: IJSN - CICLOVIAS is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Camada com geometria do tipo linha, representando a infraestrutura cicloviária da Região Metropolitana da Grande Vitória (RMGV). As vias foram traçadas pela equipe de Geoprocessamento do Instituto Jones dos Santos Neves (IJSN) a partir da interpretação visual de vários insumos cartográficos como ortofotomosaicos, serviços de mapas como Google Maps, dentre outros. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are features, Geobases, tra_ijsn_ciclovias, Brazil, BRA-Espirito Santo. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
